newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish year-end inflation 19.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish year-end inflation 19.5 pct.

text.p: Polish bankers expect year-on-year inflation in December at its current reading of 19.5 percent, a forecast unchanged from last month, a poll by the private Pentor institute showed.
In November the 202 polled bank managers expected the dollar to end the year at 2.87 zlotys, up from its current 2.80 and from the 2.82 bankers forecast last month.
They also expect the lombard rate to end the year at 24.7 percent, down from its current 25 percent.
The Pentor survey is commissioned monthly by the Polish Banking Association (ZBP).
